craft_notes: P03 REFRAIN-CANDIDATE (krīḍati parameśvarī — her play; flagged at T1, carried un-smoothed). Sthāyin: fearlessness dawning (na bhetavyaṃ). Sanskrit first: total scope (whatever changes), doubled locus (in those), refusal (not to be feared), ground (she plays) → L4 sets scope+refusal line 1, ground line 2. Rows: row 1 (play-last — krīḍati closes the verse, 'play' closes the song-line). Rupture: comma-dash after 'clay' — brewing held, fear refused. Close: end-weight on the whole doctrine ('play' — the p03 word). Minimal pass: 'mortal clay' for sataḥ (being-as-clay singable; being-doctrine in cite). Read aloud: line 1 brews (whatever/forms/brew), dash, line 2 releases (fear none/play). Rejected: 'do not be afraid' command — killed: gerundive states fearlessness, command nags; 'dances' for krīḍati — killed: play is free play, dance choreographs.

lines: Whatever forms the state may brew in mortal clay,
fear none of them — the Goddess is at play.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yāni yāni vikārāṇi avasthā kurute sataḥ / teṣu teṣu na bhetavyaṃ krīḍati parameśvarī

reads_against.argmap: No produced change is to be feared, because the Supreme Goddess plays.
c1_essence: Whatever the state brews — in none of it anything to fear; the Goddess plays.
